title: Weeknight Chilli Con Carne with Black Beans

replaces.change: Fixes the bundled data anomaly: its own lines carried 400 g soy sauce (11,165 mg sodium/serving of bundled math). This version seasons with 1 tbsp soy sauce plus no-salt-added tomato sauce, bloomed spices and lime, landing near 600 mg/serving. Kidney beans swapped for no-salt-added black beans (no committed kidney-bean row exists; documented in the part README). Ground beef kept at the bundled 400 g-plus scale; doneness is a thermometer check at 160°F, replacing the bundled 'browned all over' colour cue.

qty.note: about one 1-lb package of lean (85/15) ground beef
one 15-oz can, drained and rinsed (no salt added)
plus more at the table for heat
the umami backbone in place of the bundled 400 g soy line - taste before adding salt
about 0.75 cup cooked per bowl, from 0.5 cup dry

steps.text: Dice the onion and bell pepper, mince the garlic, and dice the tomatoes. Keep them in separate piles - they go in at different times.
Heat the oil in a deep skillet over medium-high until it shimmers. Add the beef and let it sit undisturbed for 2 minutes to take colour, then break it up and brown it hard, about 4 minutes more.
Drain the rendered fat into a heatproof jar - lean beef still releases plenty, and leaving it behind greases the whole pot.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the beef and cook, stirring, until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute, stirring - the spices should smell toasty, not acrid; pull the pan off the heat if they catch.
Add the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, black beans and half a cup of water, scraping the base clean. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer partially covered for 15 minutes, stirring twice, until thickened enough that a spoon leaves a brief trail.
Take the pan off the heat and check the beef crumb at its thickest with a thermometer: it must read 160°F (71°C) - ground beef's FSIS safe minimum.

safety.source: USDA FSIS safe minimum internal temperature table

steps.text: Stir in the soy sauce and the juice of half the lime. Taste: add a pinch of salt only if it still needs it - the soy sauce carries most of the seasoning.
Fluff the rice into bowls and ladle the chilli alongside. Finish with the remaining lime in wedges and the cilantro scattered over.

nutrition_per_serving.basis: USDA FoodData Central values committed in apps/ios/Resources/usda_ingredient_catalog.sqlite (matched fdc_id per ingredient in tables/nutrition-map.json), plus the app's shipped core-ingredient table (data.json) for items without an fdc_id; scaled by evidenced gram quantities
